what: Clicking a header menu item brings a full-width panel, hanging transparent 600px above, down into place in .7s as it fades in, and a 50% ink + 4px blur scrim covers the screen below at once. Clicking the same item · anywhere on the panel · Esc sends it back up the same path as it vanishes (the scrim lifts immediately), and clicking another item brings the new panel down while the previous one rises

options.dur: Duration of the panel lowering and raising (s), default .7
options.drop: Height at which the closed panel hangs (px, upward), default 600
options.--fx-z: Panel z-index (via style), default 2 — kept lower than the header bar so the panel slides down beneath it
options.[data-fx-part=trigger][data-key] · [data: Pair the pressed item and the panel to open with the same data-key. Inner panel contents (background panel, card row, top margin) are painted by the using side

use: Card row
note: The panel is position: fixed. If placed inside a header with a transform (such as a hide part), it attaches relative to the header and hides with it. Put data-fx on an outer element wrapping both header and panel. Give the space above the panel (header height) to the content inside the panel

from.where: index.html .g-mega (Business Domain and Our Services mega menu — wide screens only, drawer on phones)
